title: Therapeutic roles of curcumin: Lessons learned from clinical trials - MD Anderson Cancer Center
abstract:
Therapeutic roles of curcumin: Lessons learned from clinical trials. / Gupta, Subash C.; Patchva, Sridevi; Aggarwal, Bharat B. In: AAPS Journal, Vol. 15, No. 1, 01.2013, p.
In clinical trials, curcumin has been used either alone or in combination with other agents. Various formulations of curcumin, including nanoparticles, liposomal encapsulation, emulsions, capsules, tablets, and powder, have been examined. In this review, we discuss in detail the various human diseases in which the effect of curcumin has been investigated. ... Dive into the research topics of 'Therapeutic roles of curcumin: Lessons learned from clinical trials'.
